decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of budget mini-speakers and more powerful outdoor units. While the FLYSH (prod_bluetooth_speakers_125) and comiso (prod_bluetooth_speakers_020) have strong ratings for their price points, the overall selection was heavily diluted with accessories like cases and straps, as well as outdated technology (the Bose SoundDock uses a legacy 30-pin connector). The high-end option available, the UE MEGABLAST, is priced quite high at $245. Since I am looking for a mid-range, reliable speaker from a modern brand and didn't find a product that balanced sound quality, portability, and value perfectly, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
